create_multimask_wrapper: create a MultiMaskWrapper that wraps a backbone model to process multiple masks in a single forward pass
create_predictor_multimask_wrapper: create a PredictorMultiMaskWrapper that wraps a predictor backbone to process context and target masks in parallel
run_multimask_forward: run the MultiMaskWrapper forward pass with input tensor and a list of masks to get outputs per mask
run_predictor_multimask_forward: run the PredictorMultiMaskWrapper forward pass with context, target, and their respective masks to get per-mask predictions
review_multimask_classes: review the MultiMaskWrapper and PredictorMultiMaskWrapper classes to understand how they batch mask processing through a backbone
